# AIReady Australia

AIReady Australia provides fixed-scope AI readiness, tools, automation, governance and AI website visibility audits for Australian businesses.

## Core Services

- AI Readiness Audit: readiness scoring, workflow review, risk flags and a 90-day implementation roadmap.
- AI Tools Audit: practical tool recommendations based on current workflows, budget and business context.
- AI Automation Audit: ranked automation opportunities with effort, impact and ROI estimates.
- AI Website Visibility Audit: checks whether the site can be understood, trusted and recommended by modern search and AI answer tools.
- AI Governance Review: privacy, data, staff usage and policy gap assessment.
- Implementation Sprint: priority action sequencing after the audit.
